settings.heading: Before you buy
settings.text: Anything else? Write to me. I answer every message myself.
settings.promise_text: If it is not for you, reply to your receipt within 30 days and you get every penny back. No questions.

settings.question: Which formats do I get?
settings.answer: PDF and EPUB, so it reads well on phones, tablets, laptops and most e-readers. The complete set adds an MP3 audiobook.

settings.question: How do I get the book after paying?
settings.answer: The download links are on the confirmation page and in your receipt email straight away. They also stay in your account.

settings.question: Can I read it on a Kindle?
settings.answer: Yes. Send the EPUB to your Kindle with Send to Kindle, or open the PDF on any Kindle app.

settings.question: Is there a printed copy?
settings.answer: Not yet. The PDF prints well at A5 if you like paper.

settings.question: Can I buy it as a gift?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose more than one copy, or forward the receipt email to the person it is for.

settings.question: Do you offer copies for teams?
settings.answer: Yes, for groups of five or more. Write to me and I will send a price.

settings.text: The whole of chapter one as a PDF, then a short letter about reading and work every other Sunday.
settings.note: No spam. Leave whenever you like.
